column1: # Expected COLLECTED test count per Python suite. Format: <module><TAB><count>
# The Python analogue of expected_fixture_counts.tsv. run_all.sh gated the Python lane on the
# exit code of one unittest call over every module, and counted FILES rather than tests -- so
# de-collecting an entire module (test_ -> xtest_) still exited 0, because the sibling modules
# kept the total non-zero. Twenty-one rounds of adversarial hardening are stored as these tests.
# NOTE: the generator does NOT emit this header -- re-add it after regenerating, or the reason
# this file exists is deleted by the act of updating it (MOGO-023).
